SELECT 
  -- Invoices
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN curr_cd = 'USD' THEN inv_tot_amt ELSE inv_tot_amt * fx.fx_rt END)
   FROM bil_cust_inv i
   LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx ON fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH) AND fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  ) AS inv_rev,
  -- Credit memos
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN curr_cd = 'USD' THEN cr_amt ELSE cr_amt * fx.fx_rt END)
   FROM bil_cr_memo c
   LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx ON fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH) AND fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   WHERE c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  ) AS cr_memo,
  -- Canceled load fees
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN curr_cd = 'USD' THEN cust_fee_amt ELSE cust_fee_amt * fx.fx_rt END)
   FROM bil_canc_fee cf
   LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx ON fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(cf.fee_dt, MONTH) AND fx.from_curr_cd = cf.curr_cd AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   WHERE cf.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  ) AS canc_fee

all_rules.statement: A customer is a parent account. It rolls up to nothing, and it is neither a shipping site nor a bill-to party.
A load is delivered when the carrier on its final row reports the final delivery: status DLVD. A canceled load does not count as delivered.
A load can be invoiced only when a signed proof of delivery is on file. An unsigned document does not count.
Revenue and loads belong to the parent of the site that shipped.
A load is booked on its first tender: the row that does not point to an earlier row. A re-tender is not a second load.
A load is one shipment, counted once: it has exactly one first tender.
A re-tender points to exactly one earlier tender. That first row keeps status RTND and is never deleted.
A shipping site rolls up to exactly one parent account, which is its customer.
The account on a load is a shipping site, and the account that pays is a bill-to party. Neither is the customer.
Test loads are never billed.
A test load or a voided load is not a load.

rules: Carrier cost for an invoiced load is linehaul pay plus the carrier's fuel surcharge plus accessorials paid to the carrier. Cost follows the load into the period its invoice was cut.
Loads hauled by Tessaway's own fleet are settled through the same tables and are treated the same way.
Margin per load is margin for the period divided by the number of loads invoiced in the period.
Margin percentage is margin divided by revenue.
The carrier's share of a canceled-load fee is a cost in the period of the fee date.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  -- Let's check FX rates and currencies first
  MIN(eff_mo_dt), MAX(eff_mo_dt)
FROM ref_fx_rate

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT
    i.inv_id,
    i.inv_dt,
    i.curr_cd,
    i.inv_tot_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT
    c.cr_memo_id,
    c.cr_dt,
    c.curr_cd,
    c.cr_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    c.cr_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
fee AS (
  SELECT
    f.canc_fee_id,
    f.fee_dt,
    f.curr_cd,
    f.cust_fee_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    f.cust_fee_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) AS inv_usd,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) AS cr_usd,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM fee) AS fee_usd,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) - (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) + (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM fee) AS net_revenue

WITH dlvy AS (
  SELECT
    s.load_id,
    DATE(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm) AS dlvr_dt
  FROM tms_stop s
  WHERE s.stop_typ_cd = 'DL'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.load_id ORDER BY s.stop_seq DESC) = 1
),
inv AS (
  SELECT
    i.inv_id,
    d.dlvr_dt,
    i.curr_cd,
    i.inv_tot_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  JOIN dlvy d ON i.load_id = d.load_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE d.dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT
    c.cr_memo_id,
    d.dlvr_dt,
    c.curr_cd,
    c.cr_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    c.cr_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  JOIN dlvy d ON c.load_id = d.load_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE d.dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
fee AS (
  SELECT
    f.canc_fee_id,
    f.fee_dt,
    f.curr_cd,
    f.cust_fee_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    f.cust_fee_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) - (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) + (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM fee) AS net_revenue

matches.label: revenue
rules: Revenue is the invoice total, which already includes linehaul, fuel surcharge and accessorial charges billed to the customer, in the period its load was delivered; less credit memos, in the period their load was delivered; plus canceled-load fees billed to the customer, in the period of the fee date; all in US dollars, converted at the rate for the month of the document date.
A delivered load counts in its delivery period whether or not its signed proof of delivery is in. A delivered load with no invoice yet has no revenue.

matches.label: margin
rules: Carrier cost for an invoiced load is linehaul pay plus the carrier's fuel surcharge plus accessorials paid to the carrier. Cost follows the load into the period its invoice was cut.
Loads hauled by Tessaway's own fleet are settled through the same tables and are treated the same way.
Margin per load is margin for the period divided by the number of loads invoiced in the period.
Margin percentage is margin divided by revenue.
The carrier's share of a canceled-load fee is a cost in the period of the fee date.

matches.label: billable load
rules: A load can be invoiced only when a signed proof of delivery is on file. An unsigned document does not count.
Test loads are never billed. They are not waiting on anything.
The invoice is cut the day the signed proof of delivery is received. A delivered load without one has no invoice and no revenue yet.
warehouse_source: bil_pod_doc: a row for the load with signed_flg true

matches.label: revenue
rules: Revenue is the invoice total, which already includes linehaul, fuel surcharge and accessorial charges billed to the customer, in the period its load was delivered; less credit memos, in the period their load was delivered; plus canceled-load fees billed to the customer, in the period of the fee date; all in US dollars, converted at the rate for the month of the document date.
A delivered load counts in its delivery period whether or not its signed proof of delivery is in. A delivered load with no invoice yet has no revenue.
The rated linehaul on a tender (tms_load_hdr.lh_rev_amt) is not revenue: it leaves out fuel and accessorials, and it sits on canceled, test, voided and re-tendered rows that were never billed.
Revenue belongs to the customer: the parent of the site that shipped.

all_rules.statement: A customer is a parent account. It rolls up to nothing, and it is neither a shipping site nor a bill-to party.
A load is delivered when the carrier on its final row reports the final delivery: status DLVD. A canceled load does not count as delivered.
A load can be invoiced only when a signed proof of delivery is on file. An unsigned document does not count.
Revenue and loads belong to the parent of the site that shipped.
A load is booked on its first tender: the row that does not point to an earlier row. A re-tender is not a second load.
A load is one shipment, counted once: it has exactly one first tender.
A re-tender points to exactly one earlier tender. That first row keeps status RTND and is never deleted.
A shipping site rolls up to exactly one parent account, which is its customer.
The account on a load is a shipping site, and the account that pays is a bill-to party. Neither is the customer.
Test loads are never billed.
A test load or a voided load is not a load.
